intent: Implement EvoPilot Evolution Expert v1.0.0 as an independently versioned Agent-neutral Skill distribution with one conversational Core and generated Codex, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP adapters that guide installation, learning, project registration, Harness-guided Goal Target Loops, recovery, evidence, and lifecycle operations without owning Runtime truth, Harness selection, authority, credentials, or durable product state.
objective: Give novice and experienced users one portable interactive expert that explains and operates the Runtime-owned Human Interaction Protocol across supported Hosts, progressively discloses help and tutorials, and preserves complete headless Runtime operation and independent Expert upgrade and rollback.

evidence.authority: User-confirmed independent Expert design evidence; not Target or release authority.
Exact authorization to write Roadmap revisions 4 and 5 and draft and preflight this Target; not Expert implementation, Host operation, or release authority.
Current machine Roadmap defining independent Expert ownership, pre-release Suite independence proof, and post-release Cutover timing.
Current human Roadmap and Expert interaction narrative.
Published cross-Host and headless interaction baseline to inherit and retest.
Exact authorization for the Roadmap timing correction and Runtime Target revision 2 drafting; not Expert Target, commit, Candidate, acceptance, Cutover, or release authority.

include: Create a separately packaged and independently versioned @evopilot/evolution-expert workspace with its own changelog, tag namespace, Candidate, acceptance, release authorization, public artifact, upgrade, rollback, and uninstall paths.

Implement one Agent-neutral Expert Core for intent routing, progressive disclosure, schema-driven questions, deterministic rendering, installed-version help, tutorials, recovery guidance, and result explanation.
Generate Codex, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP adapters from the same Core semantics and bind every adapter to exact Core, protocol, capability, and compatibility digests.

Guide project discovery, new-project onboarding, project-definition adjustment and rollback, Harness match explanation, combined Harness plus Lifecycle plan explanation, Goal Target Loop progress, evidence inspection, recovery, acceptance readiness, and release readiness through Runtime-owned protocol objects.
Provide side-effect-free first-run tutorials, contextual documentation routing, examples, troubleshooting, and version-aware migration help.
Resume from durable Runtime-owned state after restart or Host transfer without creating Expert-owned canonical state.
Provide a third-party Host Adapter authoring and conformance kit requiring zero Engine source modification.
Prove real Codex and designated-human WorkBuddy ranges against exact Runtime and Expert Candidates plus an independent machine-operable Host path.
Preserve fully capable CLI, API, and CI Runtime operation when Expert or any one Host Adapter is absent or incompatible.

Before v5 public release, treat real EvoPilot and DataRig Codex Suites as active and independently evolving; use late-bound read-only snapshots and prove Expert independence only in isolated Candidate environments where both Suites are absent.
Keep actual Suite disablement, archival, uninstall, and retirement outside this Target and after verified v5 installation under a separate Cutover Target and separate human authorization.
exclude: Project, Lifecycle, Harness, Goal, Target, Loop, evidence, acceptance, recovery, publication, or Release truth ownership.
Harness selection, scoring, fabrication, authoring, mutation, approval, publication, Catalog mutation, or Registry mutation.
Approval identity, credentials, raw secrets, production or database authority, or durable canonical Runtime state.
Host-specific Lifecycle, Harness, authority, business, recovery, or release semantics in any generated adapter.
A general-purpose coding Agent, model loop, execution tool loop, or embedded Runtime.
Lockstep versioning or release dependency between Expert and EvoPilot Runtime.
Modifying evopilot-harness or treating its Digital Expert as this product.
Implementation, commit, push, Candidate build, acceptance, Codex or WorkBuddy operation, npm publication, GitHub Release, production access, or database access under this unapproved draft.
Any real EvoPilot or DataRig Codex Suite disablement, archival, uninstall, retirement, default switch, or mutation under this Target.

designDecisions.distribution: portable Skill package with one Core and generated Host adapters
designDecisions.truth: Runtime-owned Human Interaction Protocol objects only
designDecisions.state: durable state belongs to Runtime; Expert may keep only disposable Host session projections
designDecisions.authority: conversation, readiness, explanation, or recommendation never grants authority
designDecisions.harnessBoundary: Expert explains Runtime match results but never selects or changes Harness
designDecisions.degradedMode: CLI, API, and CI remain complete without Expert

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: Input and conversation never imply authority and raw secrets remain prohibited.

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: Human gates are exact, digest-bound, explained, and never satisfied by generic dialogue.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: The Expert explains exact Runtime Harness match and combined Harness plus Lifecycle plan for positive, ambiguous, and abstaining cases.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: canonical Runtime objects, rendered explanations, hostile prompts, and no-Harness-authority sentinels

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Automatic recovery, an unknown automation class, one rule approval, restart, resume, and Host transfer are explained and completed without Expert-owned state.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: recovery transcript, rule proposal and approval, Runtime receipts, transfer, and state audit
